# E0333: a lens body or its lacunas declare a hidden field or a definition

A lens maps data fields. A hidden field (_x) or a definition (#X) is not
data, so a lens body and its lacunas have neither. That also keeps the
operations, spelled _drop, _orelse, _match and _each, and _item from ever
naming a field.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	kind: string
}
```

`ship/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	kind: "a" | "b"
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		_match: "a"
		kind: _match(v0_0.kind, {"a": "a", [_]: "b"})
	}
	lacunas: {
		kind: [{
			type:    LossyFieldMapping
			message: "kinds other than a become b"
		}]
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0333]: the ForwardLens in 1.0.thema declares _match, a hidden field, which is not data
 --> 1.0.thema:8:3
  |
8 |         _match: "a"
  |         ^^^^^^
  |
  = note: a lens maps data fields, so a key is a field of the target, or of its lacunas, by name
  = help: remove it; to map a field whose name starts with _ or #, quote the key: "_match": ...
```
